justification: A shows a vertical, repeating vegetal frieze of stems, palmettes and rosettes ordered along a column, while B shows a single schematic frontal face with spiral eyes/ears and a curved outline, plus a smaller spiral beside it; the only real correspondence is the generic use of shallow incised outline drawing and curled volute-like elements. There is no shared subject, no shared relationship between elements, and no comparable compositional scheme (repeating botanical band versus one isolated anthropomorphic mask).
